jobs.title: Cash Operations Manager
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:
This position is responsible for and supervises the treasury operations team in Birmingham, handing the cash management of certain Southern Company subsidiaries as well as backing up the Atlanta-based treasury operations group. This involves managing the daily cash positioning of the company, managing the banking relationships, lines of credit, cash forecasting and working capital management.  The position is also responsible for supporting reporting needs from Treasury Operations.
JOB REQUIREMENTS:
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in Treasury, Finance, or Accounting required
- Must have 2 -3 years of experience leading, coaching, or directing the work of others.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Effective verbal and written communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet critical deadlines.
- Knowledge of cash positioning, liquidity management, banking services, and financial controls.
- Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders and banking partners.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Support management and help guide direct reports through driving automation and transformation initiatives.
- Hands-on experience with Kyriba TMS (cash, payments, bank account management) is a plus.
- Ability to leverage technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, documentation, and business processes.

MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage banking accounts and relationships with 6-8 banks ranging in size from small community banks to large money center banks.   - Includes negotiating bank fees.
- Meeting with bank officers.
- Resolving issues between internal stakeholders and banking partners.
- Discussing new Treasury products and services in the marketplace and bringing back suggestions to management.

- Working as a part of the management team to provide oversight of Treasury Operations services for Southern Company and its subsidiaries.  - Cash Concentration from smaller banks to aggregate cash.
- Determining Cash Position.
- Moving aggregate cash to various accounts to settle cash position.
- Making various large dollar payments such as: - Debt
- Payroll/PPP
- SCS Intercompany
- Taxes
- Lease
- Investment/CP transfers
- Credit Facility
- Other requests as needed

- Maintaining General Ledger treatment for cash transactions.
- Daily balancing and reconciliation of cash transactions.
- Daily reporting of cash and liquidity position (including bank balances, investment balances, CP outstanding and available credit).
- Reviewing Accounts Payable payment registers to ensure files are submitted correctly to the banks.
- Make check deposits.
- Provide daily activity files to Account Recon for their reconciliation process.
- Notify Accounting of incoming receipts, as well as other various reports.

- Lead support on reporting requests for Treasury Operations
- Works with management team to delegate ad hoc reporting requests to analysts - Works with treasury and other subsidiaries to develop and implement new reports as needed
- Provide month-end journals for treasury items. Additional reporting to support month-end processing includes:  - Backs up Team Lead for debt accounting journal for Southern Company system
- Bank Account Balance information
- Supports Liquidity Solutions Project Manager to provide investment balance reports (including interest income) and short-term debt reports (accruals, notional balance reports)
- APC-Daily recondition of Collections in Transit account and Office Deposit adjustments

- Lead, coach, and develop Cash Operations employees, including performance management, work prioritization, and career development.

jobs.title: SCM Category Manager
jobs.description:
SCM Category Manager
This position will be located in Atlanta, GA or Birmingham, AL.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position works within the Supply Chain Management organization to support the Generation Business Unit to maximize the value that is delivered using a category management framework. The role collaborates with senior internal stakeholders, supply chain teams, and suppliers to use continuous improvement techniques to improve internal Business Unit and supply chain outcomes. The role ensures Supply Chain Management is perceived as a positive, significant, value-adding partner to the business by providing solutions to business and operational supply chain challenges, improving processes to reduce total costs of ownership, and maintaining a strategic approach to procurement and supply management.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS
Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Technology, Finance, or other relevant technical discipline preferred
- Education or experience in contracts
- Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM) or Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) is a plus
- Professional Contract Manager (CPCM) or Certified Commercial Contract Manager (CCCM) is a plus

Experience:
- At least 2 years of progressive Supply Chain Management experience in category management, strategic sourcing, procurement, supplier relationship management, or related disciplines
- Previous category management experience required.
- Competitive bidding, strategic sourcing, and contract negotiation experience required.
- Demonstrated success developing and implementing category strategies that deliver measurable business value through cost optimization, risk mitigation, operational efficiencies, supplier performance improvements, innovation, and process standardization.
- Experience leading enterprise-wide or program-based category initiatives that drive system-wide impact across large, complex organizations, preferably within utility, power generation, industrial manufacturing, energy, or other asset-intensive environments.
- Proven ability to develop category strategies that align with business objectives and support long-term operational, reliability, and financial goals.
- Experience building strategic partnerships and influencing stakeholders across multiple business functions and leadership levels.
- Experience managing complex categories with significant annual spend responsibility preferred.
- Project management experience is a plus.
- Experience working within renewable energy categories (solar, wind, battery storage, hydro, etc.) is a plus.

Knowledge & Skills:
- Knowledge of supply markets and purchasing principles
- Professional written and verbal communication skills
- Knowledge of contract terminology
- Facilitation skills
- Proven negotiation skills
- Excellent project management
- Strong skill in use of Microsoft Office
- Comprehensive knowledge of SCM
- Financial acumen and demonstrated aptitude in analytics

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Develops and executes category plans that identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, drive cost savings, manage risk, improve safety, drive innovation, and ensure the continuous development of categories managed.
- Supervises, plans, manages, and assumes complete responsibility for all activities and processes associated with the categories assigned, potential categories include solar, wind, battery storage, hydro or other assigned categories. Developing category profiles; conducting market research to identify new suppliers, to predict stresses on the supply base, and to manage pricing (e.g., index pricing and volume discounts).
- Typically manages between $100M - $300M in annual spend
- Leads negotiations, oversees all stages of strategic procurement.
- Helps facilitate supplier performance measurement and collaborates with key suppliers to identify potential areas for improvement.
- Manages and identifies supplier alliance opportunities. Supports internal utility Business Unit's supplier management efforts.
- Performs thorough analysis to support the development of category plans, including but not limited to meeting with internal customers to understand their needs, requirements, and plans; determining the impact of joint efforts on supplier KPIs; analyzing historical spend; forecasting future spend based on demand planning; building cost models; calculating total cost of ownership (TCO); creating supplier value.
- Works with Business Unit clients to develop and manage tools necessary to track supplier performance (ex: scorecards).
- Communicates supplier performance metrics to relevant stakeholders on a regular basis.
- Interfaces with all levels of Supply Chain Management and Business Unit clients, including senior management.
- Leads and participates in cross-functional teams, including representatives from Business Unit clients, Supplier Diversity, Risk Management, and/or Legal.
- Creates and implements development plans for suppliers who do not meet performance standards and resolves conflict between suppliers and the company.
- Contributes as a member to the One SCM Category Management team by leveraging strengths to support fellow team members, sharing lessons learned, and engaging others to help in addressing knowledge or experience gaps

BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES
- Demonstrate Southern Company Values
- Safety focus and a strong personal safety record
- Dedication to an accident-free work environment with strict adherence to all safety and compliance requirements
- Must lead by example and ensure equity and fairness in interactions with others
- Must conduct self in a manner that builds trust and confidence with coworkers, contractors, supervisors, and management
- Ability to work within a team setting, including the ability to build and motivate a team toward a shared goal
- Demonstrated initiative and creativity coupled with a strong customer service focus will be expected

BENEFITS
- Competitive Pay
- Excellent benefits packages which includes: - Medical and dental coverage
- Defined Pension/Cash Balance Benefit Plan
- Performance-sharing plan
- 401(k) plan with a generous company match
- Bonus opportunities
- Tuition Reimbursement

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Southern Company Services is seeking a high-impact Human Resources Business Partner to support the Technology organization as a trusted advisor to managers, supervisors and teams. This role combines strong business partnership capability with practical HR expertise and will help translate business priorities into people strategies and provide consultative support across organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership coaching, talent and performance management, employee relations, and change initiatives. The successful candidate will bring sound judgment, strong relationship-building skills, and the ability to influence outcomes through data, insight, and collaboration. This position is based in downtown Atlanta, GA with some overnight travel.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

- Partner with Technology leaders to understand business priorities, organizational dynamics, and talent needs, and translate them into practical people strategies and actions.

- Support the execution of enterprise and business-unit HR priorities in ways that strengthen leadership capability, team effectiveness, and employee experience.

- Consult with leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent movement, performance, and change management to support business outcomes.

- Coach leaders and managers on team effectiveness, employee engagement, development, and accountability in alignment with Southern Company values and expectations.

- Use data, trends, and organizational insight to identify issues, assess risks, and recommend solutions that improve retention, capability, and business performance.

- Partner closely with HR Centers of Expertise, including Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, and Inclusion, to deliver integrated solutions that support business goals.

- Collaborate across the broader HR team to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery of HR programs, processes, and employee support.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education and Certifications :

- Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related field or equivalent job experience

- PHR or SHRM-CP certification preferred.

Experience :

- 5 years of progressive HR experience, including experience in an HR business partner, HR generalist, or other advisory role supporting leaders and employees in a complex organization; experience supporting corporate, professional, or technology-related teams is preferred.

- Demonstrated experience in a consultative HR role supporting leaders across core disciplines such as talent management, employee relations, performance management, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities :

- Broad knowledge of key HR disciplines, including performance management, leadership development, talent and succession planning, compensation, employee relations, workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, and change management.

- Strong consulting and relationship-management skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence leaders at multiple levels of the organization.

- Strong analytical capability and comfort using workforce data, trends, and insights to inform recommendations and support sound decision-making.

- Ability to connect HR strategies to business plans and develop practical solutions in areas such as organizational design, talent planning, manager effectiveness, and change adoption.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and comfort learning and using HR systems, dashboards, and reporting tools.

- Demonstrated ability to coach and influence leaders while fostering trust, accountability, and strong team performance.

- Ability to manage competing priorities, work through ambiguity, and deliver high-quality support in a dynamic environment.

- Sound judgment and the ability to navigate sensitive situations with professionalism, objectivity, and discretion.

- Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with care and integrity

- Ability to support and influence change by helping leaders and teams navigate transitions with clarity and confidence.

- Ability to build effective partnerships with business leaders and HR colleagues and tailor support to the needs of a technical client group.

- Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills.

- Self-directed, collaborative, and dependable, with the ability to work independently while contributing positively to a broader HR team.

- Strong execution focuses and commitment to delivering high-quality, business-relevant results.

- Working knowledge of employment law, HR policy, and compliance practices, with the ability to apply guidance thoughtfully in partnership with leaders and HR experts.

- Ability to demonstrate behaviors consistent with the company culture – Safety First, Intentional Inclusion, Act with Integrity, and Superior Performance.

- Will work on special HR projects where needed.

- Ability to work in-office a minimum of 4 days per week and travel up to 25% as business needs require.

jobs.title: Risk Management Associate
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:
This position provides administrative, computer and insurance service support to the SCS Risk Management Department. The support is at a higher level than is defined within the normal secretarial classification and includes decision making authority on subjects within specified boundaries.
JOB REQUIREMENTS:
- High School education or above acceptab le with 3 years job  experience
- College degree, experience in an Associate/ Administrative job position or 3+ years insurance experience preferred
- Formal or extensive informal risk management training and experience preferred
- Basic knowledge of property and liability insurance
- Insurance professional designation a plus
- Familiarity with Southern Company operations/companies/departments desired
- Ability to communicate and to initiate and perform self-directed work – verbally and written
- Work experience and familiarity with various computer programs including Microsoft Office Products is required.  Experience with Southern’s Enterprise Foundations, Oracle systems a plus

MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Processes invoices and handles routine premium allocations
- Coordinating and processing certificates of insurance and self-insurance letters
- Provide computer support including Microsoft Office Products (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc) and the Southern Company systems including Enterprise Foundations. Candidate could be responsible for entering time and/or employee data
- Prepares insurance premium tax filings as required
- Maintain and/or be able to work with various data reports which could include property values, location listings, etc
- Ideal candidate would be proficient with Excel and have aptitude for learning and working with AI within the Southern Company setting
- Obtaining renewal information for insurance policies as requested; this could include working directly with the broker on our non-profit or special event placements and would support analyst or manager in large renewals
- Communicate well with others within the company along with our brokers or insurers on our insurance and risk management programs
- Interest and ability to understand and retain knowledge of company’s insurance program
- Prepare various special projects or program materials in support of risk management team
- Responsible for ordering supplies and maintaining office equipment (Birmingham)
- Prepare expense reports as needed
- Responsible for creating and maintaining files, records retrieval and storage of records as needed
- Coordinate travel or meeting arrangements for the department if requested
- The position primarily supports the Birmingham Risk Management team but could also work with the Atlanta Risk Management team

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Financial Analyst II (GL3), III (GL4), Sr. (GL5)
Job Summary:
This position focuses on providing budget planning, forecasting and analysis for Southern Company Gas. This role primarily supports the corporate areas.   This position requires strong financial and analytical skills with the ability to work closely with business unit leaders to analyze and assess potential financial risks and opportunities.

Job Responsibilities & Accountabilities by Competency
Functional Expertise:
- Provide monthly variance reporting, trending, projections, presentations, and ad-hoc analysis to support FP&A leadership and the business leaders of the supported organizations
- Participate in the monthly close process including preparation of accruals, journal entries, reconciliations and other normal closing responsibilities as needed
- Serve as the financial lead for the business as related to the annual budget process, quarterly forecasts, and periodic internal reporting for the organization
- Work closely with business area leaders to achieve desired financial and operational results
- Assess financial performance against target, including risks and opportunities to the plan
- Performs financial and ad-hoc analysis as requested including monitoring full income statement including margin, operating expenses, other income and net income
- Works with business and FP&A leadership to evaluate and manage requests for additional funding throughout the fiscal year

Business Acumen:
- Analyzes financial and non-financial data to help drive business decisions
- Articulates results, variances and key drivers effectively
- Understands financial accounting standards and procedures and is comfortable with accruals, journal entries and reconciliations
- Develop recommendations and alternatives to meet objectives
- Demonstrates knowledge of the business and industry in analyses

Engagement:
- Fosters relationships with managers, peers, customers and is a team player
- Communicate effectively with all levels of business

- Influences business decisions by sharing analyses and expertise

Driving Results:
- Monitors results versus plan and work with business leaders to achieve desired results

- Identify process and/or profit improvements

Qualifications
Required Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent. A professional certification (e.g. CPA, CMA) or MBA is preferred.

Preferred:
- Familiar with the preparation of General Ledgers, Basic Knowledge of FASB requirements, and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

- Knowledgeable on financial principles such as net income, earnings per share, cash flow analysis, and revenue requirements

- Working knowledge of financial management information systems and tools

- Demonstrated strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and strategic focus

- Communicate with stakeholders in a clear and concise manner – demonstrates organizational savvy

- Demonstrated ability to uphold confidentiality

- Commitment to continuous personal development and process improvement

- Experience with Microsoft Office Suite with proven focus on Excel and PowerPoint

- Ability to work proactively, independently and in a team environment

Related Work Experience:
Required:
Financial Analyst II
- 2-4 years of experience in financial planning, financial analysis, regulatory planning, and/or accounting or related fields

Financial Analyst III
- 4-6 years of experience in financial planning, financial analysis, regulatory planning, and/or accounting or related fields

-

Financial Analyst, Senior
- 6-8 years of experience in financial planning, financial analysis, regulatory planning, and/or accounting or related fields

Applicants may possess a combination of equivalent education and work experience.
Working Conditions/Physical Requirements:
- Hybrid work environment.  This position currently follows a hybrid work schedule and requires this role to be in office 4 days per week (Monday-Thursday).

jobs.title: Partnerships – Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Financial Analyst

JOB SUMMARY:
Southern Power's Partnerships team works at the intersection of business development, finance, operations, commercial strategy, and external partner engagement. This role supports partnership management activities across 39 renewable assets and 13 equity and tax equity partners, helping ensure Southern Power delivers on its commitments while maintaining strong, collaborative relationships with our strategic and financial partners.
The successful candidate will gain exposure to nearly every aspect of Southern Power’s business including renewable operations, finance, business development, tax equity, project development, budgeting, market intelligence and executive-level partner engagement. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving complex business challenges, taking ownership of projects, and finding creative ways to improve processes and drive results.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:  (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills )
- Bachelor’s degree required
- Degree in technical or business field such as engineering, finance, economics, accounting, or equivalent preferred
- An MBA or advanced degree in these areas or related field is a plus
- Experience interpreting legal agreements, identifying contractual requirements and risks, and effectively communicating operational, commercial, and financial impacts to stakeholders
- Intellectual curiosity and desire to develop knowledge of renewable energy markets, partnership structures, and emerging industry trends
- Demonstrated project management skills including experience organizing and managing large volumes of information, deadlines, and stakeholder communications across multiple projects simultaneously
- Self-starter with strong organizational skills
- Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships and influence outcomes across cross-functional teams including peers, management, executives, HR, legal, counterparts within Southern Company, and external counterparties
- Highly skilled at managing multiple assignments with minimal direction in time-sensitive environment
- Excellent oral and written communication skills
- High level of proficiency with Microsoft Office products including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint
- Experience leveraging data analytics, automation, AI, or process-improvement tools to improve business processes is a plus
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately

MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Develop and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external partners.

- Serve as a trusted relationship manager for assigned partners, proactively communicating major developments, facilitating productive discussions, anticipating partner concerns, and identifying opportunities to strengthen long-term partnerships

- Support partnership governance activities by interpreting LLCA and MSA requirements, identifying actions requiring partner approval or notice, maintaining governance documentation, and assisting with risk identification and mitigation efforts

- Support the management of partnership obligations within LLC/MSA agreements, including: - Drafting, reviewing, and submitting partnership monthly, quarterly, and annual reports
- Preparing meeting materials for recurring partnership meetings and recording minutes.
- Managing partnership SharePoint sites to document deliverables and company records.
- Coordinate the development and communication of budget items.
- Coordinate the negotiation and execution of partnership consents with internal and external resources.

- Conduct internal training sessions on partnerships processes, policies, procedures, and technology tools, providing proactive guidance to internal organizations and support as issues arise.
- Support cross-functional coordination among Renewable Operations, Financial Planning, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Business Development, and other stakeholders to ensure timely fulfillment of partnership obligations and successful execution of key initiatives.
- Support strategic partnership initiatives, including partner buyouts, repowering efforts, project acquisitions, tax equity matters, and other transactions involving existing or prospective partners.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through process standardization, automation, reporting enhancements, AI-enabled tools, and governance tracking systems.

- Support SPC Market Intelligence initiatives.
